title: Two-deck Standard mirror · XMage
summary: Two fixed 60-card catalogue decks (Standard16-RG and Standard16-UB) on the XMage v2 bridge, played as seat-swapped mirrors. A small initial benchmark against random and the reference heuristic; it does not represent the full Standard card pool or competitive metagame. Hosted model outputs may vary on replay. The trusted host broker is labelled self-reported by the arena; the child agent is confined separately.
